facts.text: Amanzoe is a 2.5-hour drive from Athens International Airport.
facts.excerpt:
Athens International Airport

- Transfer
A 2.5-hour drive

facts.text: Amanzoe is deliberately designed like a modern-day Acropolis and sits on a hilltop with views of the valleys and seas of the Peloponnese.
facts.excerpt: Deliberately designed like a modern-day Acropolis, Amanzoe is poised on a hilltop with wide-screen views of the rolling valleys and smooth seas of the Peloponnese.

facts.text: The pavilions have double-height ceilings and sliding wooden doors that open onto a walled, shaded terrace and plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: Double-height ceilings and sliding wooden doors that open onto a walled, shaded terrace and plunge pool add to the extravagant sense of space.

facts.text: Accommodation at Amanzoe includes complimentary movement classes (yoga and Pilates) in group sessions.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary movement classes (Yoga, Pilates), group sessions

facts.text: Accommodation at Amanzoe includes use of all non-motorised watersports equipment at the Beach Club.
facts.excerpt: Use of all non-motorised watersports equipment at the Beach Club

facts.text: Amanzoe serves a Greek degustation menu in its open-air Amphitheatre.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a Greek degustation menu in Amanzoe’s open-air Amphitheatre, which offers space and privacy within a curving stone embrace beneath the stars.

facts.text: Amanzoe offers a private candlelit dinner in the Library.
facts.excerpt: Celebrate a special occasion or simply savour the moment with a private candlelit dinner in the Library.

facts.text: The Akari Moriawase guided dining experience gives guests a direct view into the kitchen from their table.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a direct view into the kitchen from your table, offering an intimate insight into the craft behind each dish.

facts.text: Amanzoe's restaurants are open to Aman guests and non-residents, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Restaurants are open to Aman guests and non-residents (subject to availability).

facts.text: The wellness facilities include a Watsu pool, a yoga pavilion and a Pilates studio.
facts.excerpt:
- Watsu pool
- Yoga pavilion
- Pilates studio

facts.text: The changing areas include a hammam, sauna, cold plunge and steam room.
facts.excerpt: Changing areas with hammam, sauna, cold plunge and steam room

facts.text: The sanctuary of Asclepius and the amphitheater of Epidaurus, where outdoor performances take place in summer, are less than an hour's drive from Amanzoe.
facts.excerpt: The fourth century BC sanctuary of Asclepius and amphitheater of Epidaurus (where outdoor performances take place in summer) is less than an hour’s drive

facts.text: Kilada, a fishing port with tavernas, is a 15-minute drive from Amanzoe.
facts.excerpt: it’s a 15-minute drive to Kilada, a cute fishing port with some fine tavernas

facts.text: Amanzoe has no nightlife, hip dining scene or cool shopping nearby; its appeal is isolation.
facts.excerpt: There’s no nightlife, hip dining scene, or cool shopping (the on-site boutique is airport lounge chic). The beauty of Amanzoe is its isolation.
